headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 29, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Grayson Rodriguez earning the win. Wenceel Pérez led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory, while the Toronto Blue Jays took down the Baltimore Orioles 2-1.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Eury Pérez, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right gracilis strain, and Nick Mears, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 28, 2026, with a right shoulder impingement.

The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold.

top_news.title: **Angels Soar Past Tigers 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Grayson Rodriguez earning the win. Wenceel Pérez led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Jack Flaherty pitched 5.2 strong innings for the Tigers.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in South Side Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 6-2 decision to the Chicago White Sox, as Davis Martin earned the win with 6.0 innings pitched, 5 strikeouts, and 1 earned run. Randal Grichuk led the Twins' offense with 3 RBIs on a single hit in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Red Sox 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory. Ronald Acuña Jr. led the Braves' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Orioles in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Baltimore Orioles 2-1, securing a crucial win on the road. Andrés Giménez led the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Jeff Hoffman earned the win and Louis Varland secured the save.

top_news.title: **Marlins RHP Eury Pérez Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins right-hander Eury Pérez has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right gracilis strain, retroactive to May 28, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays. The trade sent right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold to the Blue Jays.
